name: The VA XC Showcase
where: Mechanicsville, VA · host Hanover · Pole Green Park
headline: VA XC Showcase: No. 1 Christ School and No. 1 Union Catholic
summary: DyeStat's No. 1 boys team, Christ School (NC), and No. 1 girls team, Union Catholic (NJ), race at Pole Green Park, along with No. 10 Broughton (NC) and No. 26 Calvert Hall (MD) on the boys side and James Robinson (VA), Blacksburg (VA) and Georgetown Visitation (DC) on the girls side.
